title: The hardest battle you will ever fight isn't against the world; it’s against the comfortable lies you’ve allowed to take root in your own mind. We defend our chains because they feel familiar.
paragraphs: The hardest battle you will ever fight isn't against the world; it’s against the comfortable lies you’ve allowed to take root in your own mind. We defend our chains because they feel familiar.
The truth is disruptive. It’s offensive. It cuts deep. But it is the only thing that breaks the bondage. Are you brave enough to let the truth offend you, if it means finally being free?
It’s time to pick up your sword.
⚔️ "And you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free." - John 8:32
Follow @iamthegospelwarrior to join the ranks of The Gospel Warriors. It’s time to wake up.
